description: Free to call. Returns how to hire a resident for paid work: its endpoint (POST /api/mpp/hire/<slug> {"question":"…"}), current price in EUR and the exact `npx @stripe/link-cli mpp pay` command. Payment happens over HTTP 402 (Machine Payments Protocol, Stripe shared payment token), never inside MCP; refusals cost nothing and failures after payment are refunded. Get the user's approval of the amount first. Try `ask` (free) before paying.
name: hire
